FeeRebateSettings.warn:
Multiple rebates are allowed for one order. 
If multiple rebate rules are hit, commissions will be repaid to the hit rules one after another. 
A rule will only rebate commission once.
FeeRebateSettings.calculateRebateDesc: Are you sure you want to rebate the queried {{field}} orders?
FeeRebateSettings.calculateRebateTip: If no rule is matched, no commission will be returned
FeeRebateSettings.theHistoryRule: Commission rebate based on historical rules
FeeRebateSettings.theLatestRule: Rebate according to current latest rules
FeeRebateSettings.feeRebateSettingsHistoryDesc:
Orders that have received commission rebates will no longer be calculated. 
The MT5 orders queried include in and out orders. 
Click [Calculate Rebate] to calculate the rebate for the queried order. 
When calculating the commission rebate for historical orders, transaction rebates will also be calculated. 
If you do not need to calculate trading rebates, please select Off in Rebate Settings - Basic Settings - Trading Rebate Settings. 
If the latest order data cannot be obtained, try again later and wait for order synchronization.

DepositRebateSettings.warn:
One deposit allows multiple commission rebates. 
If multiple rebate rules are hit, commissions will be repaid to the hit rules one after another. 
A rule will only rebate commission once.

PammProduct.descOne: 1. The simple PAMM product will create an MT sub-account when the user buys it; after the main account closes the position, the profit and loss orders will be allocated to each sub-account according to the proportion; the user can buy at any time, and the main account can redeem it if there is no position order!
PammProduct.descTwo: 2. The share and net value of share-based PAMM products are calculated daily. After the user purchases, the share and proportion must be recalculated during the calculation; the lock-in period can be set freely; no position orders are allowed during the freezing period!

RebateBasicSettingsPage.settingDesc:
Only one of mode 1 and mode 2 can be selected.

Mode 1: Everyone is an agent. 
Non-agents can also receive commission rebates.

Mode 2: This mode can only rebate commissions to agents. 
Fixed rebates are used for each level above the settlement level; the total rebates for the settlement level and below are fixed. The first-level rebates are directly rewarded, and the remaining levels have different levels of rebates.

settleTimeRadio.0: Real-time commission will be returned to the rebate account in real time after the order is closed.
settleTimeRadio.1: Daily settlement: This is the time of day to review the rebates as of the previous trading day and settle them into the rebate account; this time is the time zone of the CRM
settleTimeRadio.2: Weekly Summary This is the time of each week to review the rebates as of last week and settle them into the rebate account; this time is the time zone of the CRM
